files.k8s/platform/deployment.yaml:
# Generated from app.yaml by arugula-salad/planter's platform-app (the app). Don't edit: the next
# build of main renders it again. Change app.yaml, or patch it from k8s/kustomization.yaml.
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: fern
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: fern
  annotations:
    # Restart the pods when an Infisical value changes (the app reads env at startup).
    secrets.infisical.com/auto-reload: "true"
spec:
  # One replica, replaced rather than rolled: the volume is ReadWriteOnce.
  replicas: 1
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: fern
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: fern
    spec:
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: ghcr
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      # The image runs as the numeric user 1000 (the Dockerfile's USER 1000:1000); a root or named
      # user fails runAsNonRoot with CreateContainerConfigError.
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        # Makes the volume group-writable by gid 1000.
        fsGroup: 1000
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: fern
          image: ghcr.io/arugula-salad/fern
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 3000
          env:
            - { name: APP_PORT, value: "3000" }
            - { name: HOST, value: 0.0.0.0 }
            # Where an OpenTelemetry SDK sends traces (Tempo), and what it calls the app. An app
            # without one ignores them.
            - { name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, value: "http://tempo.tempo.svc:4318" }
            - { name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL, value: http/protobuf }
            - { name: OTEL_SERVICE_NAME, value: fern }
            - { name: OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES, value: "service.namespace=planter-apps,deployment.environment=prod" }
            # Where the app keeps its data (SQLite, uploads): the volume.
            - { name: APP_STATE, value: /data }
          # Infisical `planter-apps-md-qs` / prod / `/fern` (STRIPE_KEY), as the Secret fern-secrets.
          envFrom:
            - secretRef:
                name: fern-secrets
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet: { path: /health, port: http }
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet: { path: /health, port: http }
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
          resources:
            requests: { cpu: 10m, memory: 32Mi }
            limits: { memory: 256Mi }
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop: [ALL]
          volumeMounts:
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
            - name: data
              mountPath: /data
      volumes:
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir:
            sizeLimit: 256Mi
        - name: data
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: fern-data
files.k8s/platform/service.yaml:
# Generated from app.yaml by arugula-salad/planter's platform-app (the app's Service). Don't edit: the next
# build of main renders it again. Change app.yaml, or patch it from k8s/kustomization.yaml.
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: fern
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: fern
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: fern
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: http
files.k8s/platform/ingressroute.yaml:
# Generated from app.yaml by arugula-salad/planter's platform-app (https://fern.apps.arugula.io). Don't edit: the next
# build of main renders it again. Change app.yaml, or patch it from k8s/kustomization.yaml.
# https://fern.apps.arugula.io, with port 80 redirected. *.apps.arugula.io resolves to the cluster, so there is no
# DNS step; cert-manager issues the certificate once the route exists.
apiVersion: traefik.io/v1alpha1
kind: IngressRoute
metadata:
  name: fern
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: fern
spec:
  entryPoints:
    - websecure
  routes:
    - match: Host(`fern.apps.arugula.io`)
      kind: Rule
      services:
        - name: fern
          port: 80
  tls:
    secretName: fern-tls
---
apiVersion: traefik.io/v1alpha1
kind: IngressRoute
metadata:
  name: fern-http
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: fern
spec:
  entryPoints:
    - web
  routes:
    - match: Host(`fern.apps.arugula.io`)
      kind: Rule
      middlewares:
        # home-cloud's shared redirect middleware.
        - name: redirect-https
          namespace: default
      services:
        - name: fern
          port: 80
---
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Certificate
metadata:
  name: fern-tls
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: fern
spec:
  secretName: fern-tls
  issuerRef:
    name: letsencrypt-production
    kind: ClusterIssuer
  dnsNames:
    - fern.apps.arugula.io
files.k8s/platform/infisicalsecret.yaml:
# Generated from app.yaml by arugula-salad/planter's platform-app (needs.secrets). Don't edit: the next
# build of main renders it again. Change app.yaml, or patch it from k8s/kustomization.yaml.
# The app's runtime secrets (STRIPE_KEY): Infisical `planter-apps-md-qs` / prod / `/fern`,
# materialized as the Secret fern-secrets. Every secret in the folder is loaded, listed in app.yaml
# or not. Every app in planter-apps can read every folder of the project: anything that must not be
# shared gets a project of its own.
apiVersion: secrets.infisical.com/v1alpha1
kind: InfisicalSecret
metadata:
  name: fern-secrets
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: fern
spec:
  hostAPI: http://infisical.infisical.svc.cluster.local:8080
  resyncInterval: 60
  authentication:
    kubernetesAuth:
      identityId: 51ff5eda-4369-4107-80bc-d11d342763fd
      autoCreateServiceAccountToken: true
      serviceAccountRef:
        name: planter-apps-secrets
        namespace: planter-apps
      secretsScope:
        projectSlug: planter-apps-md-qs
        envSlug: prod
        secretsPath: "/fern"
        recursive: false
  managedSecretReference:
    secretName: fern-secrets
    secretNamespace: planter-apps
    creationPolicy: Orphan
files.k8s/platform/pvc.yaml:
# Generated from app.yaml by arugula-salad/planter's platform-app (volume). Don't edit: the next
# build of main renders it again. Change app.yaml, or patch it from k8s/kustomization.yaml.
# A Longhorn volume for the app's data, mounted at /data (APP_STATE), replicated across nodes.
# Removing the app from the cluster deletes it and its data; there is no backup unless you set one up.
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: fern-data
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: fern
spec:
  accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]
  storageClassName: longhorn
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 2Gi
files.k8s/platform/servicemonitor.yaml:
# Generated from app.yaml by arugula-salad/planter's platform-app (needs.telemetry.metrics). Don't edit: the next
# build of main renders it again. Change app.yaml, or patch it from k8s/kustomization.yaml.
# Prometheus scrapes the app's /metrics on its Service's http port every 30s. Only Services in
# planter-apps, and no honorLabels: home-cloud's policy refuses anything else.
apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1
kind: ServiceMonitor
metadata:
  name: fern
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: fern
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: fern
  endpoints:
    - port: http
      path: /metrics
      interval: 30s
files.k8s/platform/kustomization.yaml:
# Generated from app.yaml by arugula-salad/planter's platform-app (the list of what it renders). Don't edit: the next
# build of main renders it again. Change app.yaml, or patch it from k8s/kustomization.yaml.
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - deployment.yaml
  - service.yaml
  - ingressroute.yaml
  - infisicalsecret.yaml
  - pvc.yaml
  - servicemonitor.yaml
  - dashboard.yaml

planter.top:
# https://fern.apps.arugula.io: fern on home-cloud, applied by Flux from this directory. platform/ is rendered
# from app.yaml on every build of main (don't edit it); this file is yours: add kustomize patches here
# for anything app.yaml can't say. Every app shares the `planter-apps` namespace, which the platform
# owns along with the `ghcr` pull secret and the `planter-apps-secrets` ServiceAccount.
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
namespace: planter-apps
resources:
  - platform
images:
  - name: ghcr.io/arugula-salad/fern
    # Pinned by .github/workflows/build.yml on every build of main. `unpinned` is a placeholder
    # that does not exist: the app does not run until CI has replaced it.
    newTag: unpinned
